breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains both conflicting instructions: 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid of 8x8x8 with a half shift' AND 'Ensure the k-point grid is gamma-centered.' These two directives are mutually exclusive. The ground truth removes the gamma-centered requirement, keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent failed to remove the contradictory gamma-centered instruction.
